notes: PDF contents deduplicated by full SHA256; names use first 12 hex characters after collision check.
Text extracted using pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8; PyMuPDF text-only fallback on error.
No OCR, graph digitization, numeric correction, unit conversion or inferred values.
Possible-image flag is a text-density heuristic, not a visual classification: zero text, fewer than 100 total nonwhitespace characters, or fewer than 80 nonwhitespace characters per page.
Low-text pages have fewer than 40 nonwhitespace characters in PyMuPDF extraction; partial flag if at least half the pages are low-text.
Only actual PDF files directly referenced by manifest local_path are included. PDFs inside ZIPs are outside this extraction scope.
